description_en: Query the status of origins in load balancers
description_zh: 查询负载均衡器下源站状态，一次可以传多个负载均衡器id，用逗号拼接
name: ListLoadBalancerOriginStatus

parameters.help_en: Load balancer ID. When querying multiple load balancers, separate the IDs with commas. A maximum of 100 load balancer IDs can be passed at once. Load balancer IDs can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2868897.html interface
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡器ID，查多个负载均衡器时，ID用逗号拼接，最多一次传100个负载均衡器ID，负载均衡器ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2868897.html接口获取
parameters.name: load_balancer_ids

parameters.help_en: Source address pool type. Various source address pools are configured under the load balancer, including default pools, fallback pools, and primary region pools. Only the status of origins in the default pool affects the status of the load balancer itself. Passing `default_pool` means only querying the status of origins in the default source address pool under the load balancer
parameters.help_zh: 源地址池类型，负载均衡器下配置了各种源地址池，有默认地址池、兜底地址池、一级region地址池等，只有默认地址池下的源站状态，会影响负载均衡器本身的状态。传default_pool时表示只查负载均衡器下默认源地址池里的源站状态
parameters.name: pool_type

OriginStatus.description_en: List of origin statuses under the load balancer
OriginStatus.description_zh: 负载均衡器下源站状态列表

PoolId.description_en: ID of the source address pool

PoolType.description_en: The origin pool to which the source belongs, under this load balancer. Only 'default_pool' (default address pool) will be displayed; other types will return an empty string
PoolType.description_zh: 源站所属的源地址池，在此负载均衡器下的类型，只有default_pool（默认地址池）会显示，其他类型返回均为空字符串

Status.description_en:
Status of the origin:
Healthy(healthy): The probe result is available.
Unhealthy(unhealthy): The probe result is unavailable.
Unknown(unknown): Unknown, the monitor has not yet probed.
Undetected(undetected): The load balancer to which the origin belongs is not bound to a monitor
Status.description_zh:
源站状态：
健康(healthy)：探测结果为可用。
不健康(unhealthy)：探测结果为不可用。
未知(unknown)：未知，监视器还未进行探测。
未监控(undetected)：源站所属的负载均衡器未绑定监视器

RequestId.description_en: Request ID, used for tracking the request
